camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDeviceDetail --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot-v64000' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
description_en: Queries the details of a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-detail --iot-instance-id iot-v64000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceDetail

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备所隶属的产品Key。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device that you want to query.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的设备的名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device that you want to query.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of a device, which corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The device details returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回设备的详细信息

FirmwareVersion.description_en:
The version number of the default OTA module of the device.

To query version information of other OTA modules reported by the device, see [ListOTAModuleVersionsByDevice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190622.html）
FirmwareVersion.description_zh:
设备默认（default）OTA模块的版本号。

如果需要查询设备上报过的其他OTA模块版本信息，请参见[ListOTAModuleVersionsByDevice]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190622.html）

GmtActive.description_en: The activation time of the device in GMT format

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the device in GMT format

GmtOnline.description_en: The most recent time when the device went online in GMT format
GmtOnline.description_zh: 设备最近一次上线的时间，GMT格式

IotId.description_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This serves as the GUID of the device
IotId.description_zh: 物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，作为该设备的唯一标识符

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the device

NodeType.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:
0: device. A device cannot have sub-devices. It can connect to IoT Platform directly or as a sub-device of a gateway.
1: gateway. A gateway can have sub-devices. It has a sub-device management module that maintains the topology of sub-devices and synchronizes the topology to IoT Platform
NodeType.description_zh:
节点类型，取值：
0：设备。设备不能挂载子设备。可以直连物联网平台，也可以作为网关的子设备连接物联网平台。
1：网关。网关可以挂载子设备，具有子设备管理模块，维持子设备的拓扑关系，和将拓扑关系同步到物联网平台

Owner.description_en: Indicates whether the API caller is the owner of the device
Owner.description_zh: API调用者是否是该设备的拥有者

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the device belongs

Region.description_en: The region where the device is located. This corresponds to the region of the IoT Platform service in the console
Region.description_zh: 设备所在地区（与控制台上的物联网地平台服务地域对应）

Status.description_en:
The device status. Valid values:

ONLINE: The device is online.

OFFLINE: The device is offline.

UNACTIVE: The device is not activated.

DISABLE: The device is disabled
Status.description_zh:
设备状态。取值：

ONLINE：设备在线。

OFFLINE：设备离线。

UNACTIVE：设备未激活。

DISABLE：设备已禁用

UtcActive.description_en: The activation time of the device in UTC format

UtcCreate.description_en: The creation time of the device in UTC format

UtcOnline.description_en: The most recent time when the device went online in UTC format
UtcOnline.description_zh: 设备最近一次上线的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
